LanguageData.TKUtils.Responses.EchoProtocol.Complete: A faint echo is heard in the distance.
LanguageData.TKUtils.Letters.EchoProtocol.Title: Echo Protocol Initiated
LanguageData.TKUtils.Letters.EchoProtocol.Body:
A subtle shift passes through the region—barely perceptible, yet undeniable. The temperature drops without wind, the light softens without cloud, and an uncanny stillness blankets the land.
Colonists report inexplicable relief from chronic pain, closed wounds without treatment, and dreams not their own—visions of a place bathed in impossible light and silence.
No signal was sent. No device detected. Yet the signature resembles a degraded instance of the Sanctuary Protocol: a fragmented response, likely triggered by local conditions.
Its purpose is unclear. Its origin, older than memory.
This is not salvation. It is only an echo.
